title: Let the reviewer spare individuals from a wave, signed into the approval
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set grew by 2 files, both named by slot A's builder as the hook for this card: app/_lib/screen-wave-contract.ts (recruiterSpared added to SCREEN_REASON_CODES, which moved there in wave 1) and decisionsWaveKeepKind.test.ts (its ALL list). decision-config-schema.ts was not touched. (2) perf-budget.json (shared surface, under the lock): app/page.tsx maxKb 8855 -> 8860 for this card's 4079 bytes, no new module. (3) Series is messages (lock) -> docs (lock) -> perf (lock) -> feat with tests, not test-then-feat: the tests are red without the code, so a test-only commit would not be green. Red was measured on the base by swapping the base versions of the six source files back in: 7 of 8 red; case 3 (a spare of someone kept anyway is a no-op) passes vacuously on a server that ignores spare and stands as a regression guard. (4) Case 3's token equality runs under a pinned Date.now (the token embeds issuedAt ms). (5) Added a machine field `previewSpare` (the list the displayed preview was computed with) so the commit always echoes the list its token was signed over, even if a toggle races the commit; the server would refuse a differing list as mismatch anyway. (6) No optimistic row move: a toggle marks the button pressed and the row moves when the re-preview (350ms debounce) returns.
notes: Gate ruling honoured: the token signs the post-spare set, spare is applied after reinstated+holdout so only real would-rejects can be spared, and a commit whose list differs re-derives a different set -> 409 mismatch (tested). Every red gate is foreign in-flight work, re-run after a wait: tsc exits 2 only on untracked kpi-sim/ (PassPreviewModal i18n errors cleared on the re-run once that sibling committed its keys); i18n:check red only on AUTOMATION_SELECTION_INVALID from a sibling's uncommitted app/_lib/api-response.ts; test:unit red only on recipes-literals (PassPreviewModal.tsx noticeAmber) and rate-limit-contract (jds/[slug]/ingest-job, uncommitted sibling); test:perf red on job-ingest 403/400 (known), db.ts importers 28/27 (not mine, I added no db.ts import) and page.tsx 8863/8860, where the residual 3 KB over my raised ceiling is uncommitted sibling work. The new event is written through recordAutomationEvent with actorRef human:<approver>, so decision-attribution's writer-derived guard sees it. screen-wave-spare.ts is import-free and server-only today (route + screen-wave.ts).
